title: Oracle Commerce Cloud pricing - Page-view tiered subscription
clean_text: Oracle Commerce Cloud uses a page-view based subscription model with Standard and Premium tiers. The Standard tier minimum commitment is 20 million page views annually, at a minimum list cost of approximately $400,000 per year. The Premium tier has a lower minimum of 1 million page views annually but at a higher per-unit rate, totaling approximately $800,000 per year at list pricing. Mid-sized retailers report base subscriptions starting around $180,000 per year with usage-based charges adding $50,000 to $70,000 annually.
